exemptions.why: The framework requires this method's callback to return an array.
The framework supplies an array to this method's callback.
This framework boundary takes arrays carrying values in its declared input format.
A class whose whole job is handing the framework arrays: its array returns are contractual.
One end of a two-way association the framework requires both ends to name: it carries no dependency direction and cannot close a cycle.
A framework entry point: behaviour does not move onto it, and a method taking one may unpack its input.
A provider or framework construction hook that wires config into values without constructor injection.
A framework-mandated method whose signature the framework dictates.
A type whose framework supplies members at runtime.
A type the framework instantiates itself, without the container.
A framework factory builds a validation response from field messages and has no parameter for the caught failure.
